title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Donuts Raspberry Jam 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co.’s Seriously Donuts Raspberry Jam e-liquid expertly pairs warm donut pastry notes with a rich, sticky raspberry jam flavour. The profile leads with a soft, comforting Donut base that is quickly followed by the bold, jammy sweetness of Raspberry syrup. This fruity centre provides a vibrant contrast to the doughy foundation, resulting in a perfectly-layered and endlessly satisfying dessert vape experience. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
